summary.ru: Проёмы плавнее перемещаются на больших планах без повторного расчёта соседних этажей.
summary.en: Opening drags stay responsive on large plans without rebuilding neighbouring floors.

rationale: Stable v1.82.0 _opPointerMoveNow mutates the saved opening and increments the configuration epoch on changed frames, and the live renderer requests the complete floor union. Retaining a transient local host projection repairs existing Plan dragging; persisted fields, canonical geometry algorithms, validation and the writer protocol remain unchanged.

goldenChecks.reason: Existing thick-wall corner geometry, seams and hatch must retain exact indexed pixels after local opening preview changes.
Settled dark masonry and opening geometry stay exactly indexed; moving-preview and before/after controls are independently recorded.
Settled light masonry and opening geometry stay exactly indexed; inherited Plan mode-tab discrepancies are not authorized as task changes.
